name: jwtVerify
description: Verifies a JWT's HMAC signature and returns its payload claims as a struct. Throws when the token is malformed, the signature does not match, the token's algorithm does not match the expected algorithm (when one is given, guarding against algorithm-substitution attacks), or the token is expired (exp) or not yet valid (nbf). Only HMAC algorithms are supported: HS256, HS384 and HS512. This is the Lucee crypto-extension name; RustCFML does not provide the Adobe verifySignedJWT name.

params.name: token
params.description: The JWT to verify (three dot-separated base64url parts).

params.name: key
params.description: The HMAC secret key the token was signed with.

params.name: algorithm
params.description: Optional expected algorithm (HS256, HS384 or HS512); when given, a token signed with a different algorithm is rejected.

examples.title: Round trip
examples.description: Sign a token and verify it back.

examples.title: Wrong key fails
examples.description: A signature check with the wrong secret throws.
